resources.string: Zeyao reads the browser address bar so it can show a summary before a news page opens. Your API key never leaves the device (it is only sent to the AI provider you chose), and unrelated screen content is not collected.
Local VPN is on. Traffic is not sent to a remote server.
Enable Zeyao’s accessibility service in system settings to read full news URLs.
You can change this later in Other.
Read the key points before the article opens.
Choose the AI provider for summaries. The key stays on this device only.
The key is stored encrypted on this device only. It is never written to source, logs, or the cloud. Zeyao uses it only to request summaries from %1$s.
Initialization failed. Check the network and key, then try again.
Intercept news URLs and show Zeyao before the article opens.
Turning this on will request local VPN permission.
Keep intercepting as a foreground service and try to restore after reboot. The system may ask you to ignore battery optimization.

Off by default. When on, a small floating button appears. Tap it once to arm the next click. WeChat and Google Discover are preferred. If WeChat has no URL in the node, long-press to copy the link, then tap again. Requires accessibility and overlay permission.
Off by default. When on, Zeyao tries to go back immediately so the original page is less likely to load. Some apps may still navigate.
Current: %1$s. The same article will not be intercepted again during this time.
Currently using %1$s. The key stays on this device. You can reconfigure the provider and API key here.
Even when intercept is off, you can paste a news URL to preview the Zeyao page. Back and Open appear immediately; the summary streams in.
Choose the interface language. Some text updates the next time you open the related page.
Zeyao %1$s\nA Wusper app. Intercepts news pages locally and generates streaming summaries with your own AI key.
Intercept only on selected weekdays and hours. Overnight ranges (e.g. 22:00–07:00) are supported.
Current: all apps. Tap to intercept only specific apps.
Current: %1$d apps selected. Clear to mean all.
Granted. Traffic stays on this device.
On. Only reads the browser address bar.
Off. Tap to open system settings.

Zeyao certificate is installed. When on, the local VPN decrypts HTTPS on this device so full article paths and page text can be read. The system may show a connection warning; some apps or sites that only trust system certificates may fail to connect. Off by default.

Install the Zeyao certificate first. Tap “Zeyao certificate” to save the file to Downloads, then go to Settings → Security → Encryption and credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate and choose “ZeyaoCA.crt”. Some sites or apps may then fail to connect.
Installed as a user certificate. Tap to save “ZeyaoCA.crt” to Downloads again.
Not installed. Tap to save “ZeyaoCA.crt” to Downloads and show the install steps.
Zeyao is the default browser. Non-news links go to the browser specified below.
Not set. Tap to ask the system, so links can be intercepted before the page opens.
Couldn\'t open the system default-apps screen. Please set Zeyao as the default browser in system settings.
Not set. The device’s usual browser will be used.
Actual browser: %1$s. Tap to choose where “Open” or non-news links go.
Open on the left, Back on the right
Open on the right, Back on the left
When on, generation finishes in the background and is written to recent records after Back or Open. When off, it stops immediately.
When on, DeepSeek first calls the official Search API to verify the news, then summarizes. Other providers are asked to verify via the prompt.
Adds safety reminders to the prompt and asks the summary to start with fraud and threat risk percentages.
Extracts key facts, searches to verify them, then adds the results to the summary context. May be slower.
Off by default. When on, a screenshot is saved locally every few seconds (2 at most). Only when a page is intercepted is the previous frame sent to the lightest model to recover a title or link.

This is experimental. Screenshots are stored only in this app’s private folder (2 at most). A frame is uploaded to your AI provider (lightest model) only when a page is intercepted, to recover a title or link.
The Zeyao CA expires in %1$d days. Reinstall it when you can.
When on, HTTPS decryption applies only to news sites, which lowers risk.
Pinned system sign-in hosts (such as Google and Microsoft accounts) are never decrypted.
Comma-separated. Leave blank to use the built-in list. Press Done to save.
Customize the model, temperature, intensity, and API key for search/extract, summarize, and verify.

The provider is still a global setting, currently %1$s. All three roles use this provider, but each can have its own model, temperature, intensity, and API key. Leave a role key blank to use the shared key below.
Used when a role key is left blank. It stays on this device.
Used to extract search keywords, check facts, and recover a title from an experimental screenshot.
Used to write the news brief.
Used in the checking overlay to decide whether a page is news.
Enter one model, or a comma-separated fallback list. Leave blank to use the built-in list. Press Done to save.
Controls keyword-extract length and how many search results to fetch. 3 is the default (about 5 results).
Controls summary length and reasoning effort when the provider supports it. 3 is the current default.
Controls reply length and reasoning effort for verification. 1 is the default (faster, lighter). Higher values may be slower.
Leave blank to use the shared key
This uses a local CA to decrypt traffic on this device. Only turn it on if you trust this setup. You can limit it to news hosts. Some sites or apps may then fail to connect.
Zeyao will try to block the original click. This can affect other apps. Confirm if you want to turn it on.
Selecting none means all apps. If you check any, only those apps are intercepted.
No summaries yet. Turn intercept on, then open a news page.
Accessibility is off (full URLs cannot be read)
When on, every page is intercepted and summarized, without news classification.
On. You will be asked whether to summarize.
On. Every intercepted page is summarized.
On: ask before summarizing. Off: always summarize.
Yes: a prompt appears after intercept.\nNo: the summary page opens immediately.
Please allow the overlay permission first
The file is in “%1$s”.\n\nGo to Settings → Security → Encryption and credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate, then choose that file.
Summary failed. You can still enter or go back.
The article URL is not available yet. You can still enter or go back.
No API key is set. You can still enter or go back.
Pages on this site will open normally. You can undo this in Settings.
No skipped sites yet. You can choose “Don’t intercept this site” on a summary page.
This summary will be removed from recent records and cannot be undone from here.
Off by default. When on, opening the Zeyao home screen requires your fingerprint, face, or device unlock. The verify float and summary page stay unblocked.
Use your fingerprint, face, or device unlock to continue.
This device has no biometric or screen lock available, so this cannot be turned on.
